inlines.v: RELUCT'ANT, adjective 1. Striving against; unwilling; much opposed in heart. Reluctant now I touch'd the trembling string. 2. Unwilling; acting with slight repugnance; coy. 3. Proceeding from an unwilling mind; granted with reluctance; as reluctant obedience.
